videos.description:

videos.title: Orion Rising in the Night Sky ✨ #shorts
videos.description:
Orion, the hunter, caught in the night sky. You can see the three stars of Orion's Belt in the middle of the frame. Betelgeuse and Rigel mark the shoulder and the foot. Orion is one of the easiest constellations to find, and it's at its best in the evening sky from late autumn through winter.

Take a second tonight and look up. 🌌

#Shorts #Orion #Stargazing #NightSky #Constellation #astronomy
